text: Dracula robbed a blood bank. Worst decision of his afterlife. Five hundred bags. One night. A perfect heist. He drank every single one. Every donor was an energy drink addict. His heart started beating. For the first time in four hundred years. He didn't sleep for three months. He started a podcast. He did his taxes. Twice. Then the sun came up. He was too wired to notice. For about four seconds. Coffee or energy drinks? Dracula needs to know.
